candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance increment with an assignment so the deposited value overwrites rather than accumulates.
Delete the statement that credits msg.value to the holder's balance.
Replace the clamped unlockTime assignment with the raw _unlockTime, which may set a past timestamp.
Delete the statement that deducts _am from acc.balance, so the sender's balance is never reduced when collecting.
Replace the balance subtraction with an addition: acc.balance = acc.balance + _am, so collecting increases instead of decreases the stored balance.
Change the guard acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>_am, blocking collection of the exact full balance.
Change the time guard block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime, allowing collection at exactly the unlock time.
Change acc.balance>=MinSum to acc.balance>MinSum, so a balance of exactly MinSum can no longer be collected.
Invert the success check: on a successful call revert and on failure log, breaking collection while still recording log entries.
Send 0 wei to the caller instead of _am (call value {value: 0}), so no ether is transferred while balance and log still change.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call, so successful collections are no longer recorded in the log history.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so deposits are no longer credited.
Replace the unlock-time assignment so _unlockTime is stored unconditionally, even if it is in the past.
Replace the balance update so it overwrites the balance with msg.value instead of adding to it.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so Put no longer logs to the Log contract.
